test_title: PYST 40: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

I __has mailed__ you the invoice.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the** incorrect use of the verb** **"has" with "I."**
 
• The correct auxiliary verb to use with **"I" is "will."**
 
• Also, the verb** "mail"** should be in its base form when used with **"will."**
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase should be** "I will mail you the invoice."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I **will mail **you the invoice."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "has mail" is incorrect because the verb should match the subject "I."
 
• **Option 2:** "No improvement" is incorrect because the sentence contains a grammatical error.
 
• **Option 3:** "will mailed" is incorrect because "mailed" should be in its base form "mail."
 
• **Option 4:** "will mail" is correct and aligns with the subject "I."
